verdict.rationale: YYLO's Ledger stores task intent, wiki, workflow and artifact data natively in Git-backed records (Markdown, YAML, JSON-like Records) rather than a proprietary database, and workflows can be saved as plain YAML, meaning users are never locked into a closed format and can walk away with their repo intact (yylo-docs-19, yylo-docs-20, yylo-docs-4, yylo-docs-15). However there is no explicit 'export all data' command or documented full-data-portability guarantee, and probes show no llms.txt/OpenAPI/machine-readable export surface (yylo-probe-1, yylo-probe-2, yylo-probe-3). Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-export/migration command, documentation of what artifact payloads look like outside Git, and independent confirmation of lock-in-free exit.
